Corollary
[Injectivity radius bound under an upper sectional curvature bound] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0307 ↗ appb-thm-rauch-comparison 1. Corollary B.22\group comparison-theorems

Under an upper sectional curvature bound by $K>0$, the exponential map is an immersion on the open ball of radius $\pi /\sqrt K$ in each tangent space.

Proof

Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0307 \sketch This is the standard consequence of Rauch comparison for the model sphere of constant curvature $K$.

□
